notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: Hey all I made some small fixes for the game. Most of it is to hopefully fix the fps on the fallen cathedral map. I also made a few fixes for the sound on both maps so all sounds should work when changing the volume.

notes.title: Release Date ANNOUNCED!!!!
notes.notes:
[u][b]Peak Darkness will Release October 31, 2022[/b][/u]

Thank you for all being patient the Release is finally here.  Halloween Day you can fight the monsters that are out and about.  Try to survive in this FREE Monster Wave Shooter.  Best of luck to all of you!!

notes.title: Release Date being moved.
notes.notes: Do to some set backs and wanting to make you a great game.  We need to move back the release date.  The release date is getting moved back for one month for right now.  I hope you all will keep watching and look forward to the game.  Thank you for your patience.
